cells.gaps: The only row on the National Digital Roadmap 2026-2030 is the November 2025 start of its formulation; no later row says it was validated or adopted, and no text, plan or reporting is held. The Smart Zimbabwe 2030 Master Plan (to 2030) has one row (ZWE-002, governance, 2019, outside the 36-month window) and none on its standing, text, plan or reporting, so it cannot be placed above stage 2 either. Stage 3 needs an adopted instrument with a row showing its text is public.
cells.note: Staged on the National Digital Roadmap 2026-2030: a process to define it began on 2025-11-04, so stage 2. Nothing held shows it adopted, with a public text.
